hints: [H+] flows outward from the Sun. A building that pulls resources outward can capture it for you.
An Extractor draws resources from the ring below and pushes them outward. Place one on the outer ring to feed [H+] to a waiting ship.
Build a building on the ring. Click on it and make it an Extractor, choose [H+] as the extracted resource.
[Hi+] is made from [H+] and [St-]. [Ir-] arrives on the outer rings and flows inward, look for the building type that pulls resources in that direction.
Use an Inserter to bring [Ir-] inward. Build a [St-] factory ([Ir-]→[St-]), then a [Hi+] factory ([H+]+[St-]→[Hi+]) where outward-flowing [H+] and inward-flowing [St-] can both reach it.

Inject [Ir-] on the outer ring, then place an Inserter on the ring below to pull it inward. Build a [St-] factory where [Ir-] flows past. Build a [Hi+] factory where both [H+] (carried outward by an Extractor from Sol) and [St-] (carried inward by an Inserter) converge on adjacent rings.
[Bg+] needs [T+], which is made from [Cf-] transformed at the Sun. Some resources change when they are discarded into the Sun.
Build a [Cf-] factory ([Ir-]+[Cu-]). [Cf-] flows inward to Sol and transmutes to [T+], which flows back outward. Catch it with a [Bg+] factory ([H+]+[T+]).

Inject [Ir-] and [Cu-] on outer rings, carry them inward via an Inserter to a [Cf-] factory. [Cf-] reaches the Sun and transmutes into [T+], which flows back outward, where a [Bg+] factory ([H+]+[T+]) can finish the job.
[Mt+] needs three ingredients flowing from different directions: [Cu-], [St-] and [T+]. Plan your factory layout so they converge.
Build [St-] from [Ir-], [Cf-] from [Ir-]+[Cu-], and transmute [Cf-] at Sol for [T+]. Position a [Mt+] factory where [Cu-], [St-] and [T+] all have lanes passing within range.

Route [Ir-] and [Cu-] inward via an Inserter. Build [St-] on a middle ring. Build [Cf-] further out so its product flows to Sol and returns as [T+]. Place the [Mt+] factory where [Cu-] (injected), [St-] (flowing inward) and [T+] (flowing outward from Sol) can all be seen from two rings above it.
[XC+] is the final step in a long chain. Follow each recipe backward: [XC+] needs [XB+] and [Cu-], [XB+] needs [XA-], [XA-] needs [Hi+] and [Cf-].
Build the [Ir-]→[St-]→[Hi+] chain and the [Ir-]+[Cu-]→[Cf-] chain. Then chain [XA-] ([Hi+]+[Cf-]) → [XB+] ([XA-]) → [XC+] ([XB+]+[Cu-]). Each factory feeds the next in sequence.

With 8 rings you have room to spread out. From outer to inner: inject [Ir-] and [Cu-] → [St-] and [Cf-] factories → [Hi+] factory → [XA-] → [XB+] → [XC+]. Move each product onward to the ring where the receiving factory sits.
[SW+] has three inputs: [Ir-], [CG+] and [G+]. [G+] comes from [Si-], and [CG+] comes from [Bg+] and [Cu-].
Build three parallel branches: [Si-]→[G+] (flows outward), the [Cf-]→[T+]→[Bg+]→[CG+] chain, and the [Ir-] injector. Merge all three at a [SW+] factory.

Inject [Si-] on an outer ring with a [G+] factory. Build the transmutation chain: [Cf-] ([Ir-]+[Cu-]) → Sol → [T+] → [Bg+] ([H+]+[T+]) → [CG+] ([Bg+]+[Cu-]). Route the injected [Ir-] so both the [Cf-] factory and [SW+] can pull it from above. Place [SW+] where the outward [G+] and [CG+] streams and the injected [Ir-] all pass within two rings.
[XD+] is the meeting point of three branches: [XA-] to [XB+] to [XC+], [T+] to [Bg+] to [CG+], and [Si-] to [G+]. There is no [Ir-] supply, so skip the [St-]/[Hi+]/[Cf-] line entirely.

The middle of the map is full: Ring 4 must carry [Cu-], [CG+], [Bg+] and [G+], and Ring 3 must carry [XA-], [XB+], [XC+] and [XD+] - all four lanes on each. Put the [XB+], [XC+] and [XD+] factories on Ring 2 so they can see Rings 3 and 4, and the [CG+] and [G+] factories on Ring 3.

Inject [XA-] on Ring 3, [Cu-] on Ring 4, [Si-] on Ring 5 and [T+] on Ring 2. On Ring 1, an [H+] Extractor feeds the [Bg+] factory together with the injected [T+]; on Ring 3 make [CG+] and [G+]; on Ring 2 chain [XB+] to [XC+] to [XD+]. Carry [XD+] outward to Ring 6 and ship it from there.

No transmutation is needed here: [T+] arrives from an injector. Everything is built from five injected streams - [Ir-], [Cu-], [T+] and two [Si-] feeds. The two hard parts are [OO-], which needs four inputs, and [OP+], which needs three.

Rings 5 and 6 are the pinch points: Ring 6 must carry [Bg+], [CG+], [G+] and [SW+], and Ring 5 must carry [Si-], [Hi+], [OO-] and [OP+] - all four lanes on both. Put [OO-] on Ring 6 (it sees [Si-] and [Hi+] one ring above, [Bg+] and [SW+] two rings above) and [OP+] on Ring 4 (it sees [OO-] and [Si-] one ring above, [G+] two rings above).

Inject [Ir-] and [Si-] on Ring 7, the second [Si-] on Ring 5, [Cu-] on Ring 3 and [T+] on Ring 2. On Ring 1 build the [H+] Extractor with the [Bg+] and [CG+] factories, and on Ring 2 the [Hi+] factory. Lift [H+], [Bg+] and [CG+] to Ring 4 (and [Bg+]/[CG+] on to Ring 6) and [Hi+] to Ring 5. Build [St-], [G+] and [SW+] on Ring 5, [OO-] on Ring 6 and [OP+] on Ring 4, then ship from Ring 8.
Both [D+] and [T+] are transmuted by Sol. You must extract both while also jettisoning [Vt-] and [Cf-] into Sol.
Focus first on transmuting [T+], you will need this to produce [Mt+], and you will then need both [Mt+] and [T+] to produce [Vt-] on Ring 3.
You need all of [Cf-], [Vt-], [T+] and [D+] on Ring 2, and the [Mt+] factory must be on Ring 4.
[Rs+] exists only inside the Sun: discard [Qg-] into the Sun and it transmutes into [Rs+]. [Qg-] = [D+] + [T+] - the first compound made from two transmuted resources.
Ring 2 must carry [T+], [D+], [Cf-] and [Rs+] - all four of its lanes. There is no room for [Vt-] and [Qg-], so make [Vt-] and [Qg-] on Ring 1, where a [-] product drops straight into the Sun.

Inject [Ir-] and [Cu-] on Ring 7. Build a [Cf-] factory on Ring 5 to keep the [T+] transmutation fed. [St-] on Ring 6, [Cu-] Inserted down to Ring 3, [Mt+] on Ring 2 pulls [Cu-], [St-] and [T+]. On Ring 1: [Vt-] from [Mt+]+[T+] and [Qg-] from [D+]+[T+] drop straight into the Sun to become [D+] and [Rs+]. Extract [T+], [D+] and [Rs+] from the Sun, then carry [Rs+] outward and ship it from Ring 7.
